## Direct certificate of an established tensorization failure

This edition records a complete direct proof and full mathematical audit for problem 30004587 / OWR-4990370-005. Ordinary logarithmic-mean GE(1,∞) holds for the normalized qubit depolarizing semigroup and the identity semigroup on a second qubit, but fails for their tensor product.

The underlying amplification failure is prior work. [Brannan–Gao–Junge, Advances in Mathematics 394 (2022), 108129](https://par.nsf.gov/servlets/purl/10355667), §4.4, in the paragraph immediately before Proposition 4.21, explicitly establishes GE((I−τ₂)⊗id_M₂)<1 using a Bell-state construction. The same statement already appears in [arXiv:2007.06138v2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2007.06138v2). The unamplified qubit estimate GE(1,∞) is established by [Münch–Wirth–Zhang, arXiv:2401.05179v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.05179v1), Theorem 3.23 and Remark 3.24. Together with the identity factor's zero derivation, these results already imply the failure at issue. This is an explicit direct certificate and reconstruction of that consequence, not a claim of a new counterexample or mechanism.

The manuscript independently proves the factor estimate for all complex observables, all densities and all times. It then verifies the ambient tensor differential calculus and gives a positive definite rational density and rational self-adjoint observable at t=log 2. The strict comparison reduces to 81>75. No novelty, historical-priority or claim that the historical source question remained open before this work is made.

## Exact accepted scope

The source's finite tracial semigroup class does not require ergodicity. The identity factor is deliberately nonergodic; this is not a counterexample with two ergodic factors. The argument does not settle preservation of a fixed nonpositive K or the optimal weaker tensor bound, and does not contradict complete-GE tensorization. Rescaling gives the same failure for each prescribed positive K.

## Complete proof, audit and attribution

The entire 11,028-byte proof and entire 8,077-byte independent mathematical audit are included byte-for-byte. A complete later prior-work attribution addendum accompanies them and qualifies how the result is presented. The edition acceptance preserves the mathematical verdict while making the established-result status explicit. A separate complete reading accepted the same nonergodic scope.

Historical checker discussions and reproduction instructions remain in the full audit. Running that historical command requires omitted supplementary files; this proof-only edition supplies no executable, fixture, standalone computational output or log, and publishes none of their hashes. The selected audit manifest is expressly labeled as an edition selection. The written universal argument and exact rational comparison supply the proof.

These are AI-assisted mathematical/source audits, not external human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant verification.

## Exact addition-only boundary

Add exactly ten files under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30004587/`. No QUEUE.md or unrelated file is changed. No copied third-party source documents, source text, renderings, datasets, derived source-text fingerprints, private sources, private storage paths or coordination files are included. Public PDF identities and inspection history are metadata only. Hashes and clean additive-patch replay establish packaging integrity, not mathematical truth. Draft for review; no merge or release is requested.
